# CC09: 宝相寺 Baoxiang Si

Wave 3 · Changchun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=CC09` · Page: `/scenes/#CC09` · Row: `research/buildings/CC09-baoxiang-si/`

## What it was

宝相寺 Baoxiang Si, a Buddhist temple east of 法慧寺 on the north side of Changchun Yuan (S05 j83:12a; E0171). 日下旧闻考: gate facing south, then 澄光阁, then 昙霏阁, then on a raised base the hall 现大圆镜, inner plaque 香臺華鬘 (S05 j83:12a). Finished 1747; S361 gives the five-bay tower 澄光阁 with side halls 云窦 and 松关, and the five-bay 现大圆镜 on a high terrace with a three-bay annex (E0179). A Qianlong presentation plan of both temples exists (样069-1, E0175). Jiaqing visited in 1796-1801 (E0176-E0178); the emperor took officials through it in 1856 (E1524). Not among the buildings left standing after 1860 (E0451, after 刘敦桢), so it burned in October 1860 (S02 pp.187-188).

From the inventory row: **built** 1747; **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S47, S01, S361).
